description:
Embark on a journey through the enchanting 10,000 Islands, a sanctuary for stunning bird species that call these islands home or use them as a pitstop on their migratory route. Best of all, all profit made from this tour goes directly to supporting Audubon Western Everglades' vital conservation efforts!

Explore the hidden world of birdlife that thrives among the mangroves and along Florida's picturesque coastline. These islands are teeming with Critical Wildlife Areas where nesting shorebirds lovingly raise their chicks, and the mangrove islands provide Bird Rookeries.

Not only will you feast your eyes on a dazzling array of birds, but you'll also glean precious insights into their behavior and conservation, thanks to the expertise of Brittany. This tour isn't
just about birdwatching; it's a chance to connect with Audubon Western Everglades and become part of their stewardship mission.

Onboard our vessel, you'll be equipped with essentials for your birding expedition: water to keep you refreshed, a birding field guide to deepen your knowledge, and binoculars to enhance your bird-spotting abilities. Feel free to bring along your own snacks, drinks, binoculars, and cameras to make this adventure truly your own.

Our tours are carefully scheduled to align with the ever changing rhythms of nature, including bird migrations, tides, and weather conditions. Keep in mind that each tour is unique – not all
bird species may make an appearance. For example, the majestic White Pelicans grace us with their presence during winter, and wading birds may choose to stay hidden during high tide. Expect the unexpected on every excursion!

Please note that tours are subject to cancellation if weather conditions pose any risks to our cherished guests and crew's safety.
